info.name: Dom
info.plot: Un padre che non ha mai smesso di combattere contro le droghe. Un figlio che non ha intenzione di smettere di servirsene. Due facce della stessa moneta. Victor è un poliziotto che ha combattuto per tutta la vita per frenare il traffico di cocaina. Suo figlio è un tossicodipendente che è diventato uno dei ladri più ricercati di Rio de Janeiro. L'amore di un padre sarà sufficiente per salvare la vita di suo figlio?

seasonIndex.plot: Inspired by the true story of Pedro Dom, the handsome bandit from Rio de Janeiro who made headlines across Brazil. Catch up with Season 1 and get ready for what's next in Season 2. We will see an even more exciting continuation of this story between a father who lives to fight againist drugs and a son who lives to indulge in them.

Making news headlines, Dom becomes the most wanted criminal in Rio. The police close in on him and he needs an escape plan. Victor goes to war with the rotten side of the police and hides in the Amazon rainforest to protect himself. Crime is everywhere. Living can be fatal.

episodes.name: KIDS DON'T COME WITH INSTRUCTIONS
episodes.plot: Rio de Janeiro, 1999. When a young middle-class guy gives in to drug addiction, his father, a policeman, goes to his rescue in the slums. Victor is a father whose mission in life is to win the war on drugs. Meanwhile, his son Pedro keeps losing his battles against them. Being on opposite sides of the same war will cause their relationship to crumble.

episodes.name: METAMORPHOSIS
episodes.plot: Facing threats and unable to fight against his addiction, Pedro meets Jasmin and joins a gang of luxury home burglars. Victor seeks out an informant in an attempt to find his son's whereabouts. In 1970, a young Victor takes part in his very first big drug bust.

episodes.name: DESTINY WITH A CAPITAL D
episodes.plot: After a failed attempt to reconcile with his father, and upset by the mistakes of the previous robbery, Pedro considers quitting, only to come up with a plan for an even bigger burglary. In 1970, Victor infiltrates the slum and meets the drug lord who wants to make cocaine popular in Rio de Janeiro.

episodes.name: WHOSE FAULT IS IT?
episodes.plot: Pedro becomes annoyed at Lico’s constant blunders during their robberies. In 1995, at age 14, Pedro and Lico started doing cocaine. They carried out their first burglaries to support their addiction. In the 1970s, young Victor is pressured into snorting coke for the first time. He questions his own actions as an undercover agent and considers walking away from the mission.

episodes.name: CRASHING
episodes.plot: At the age of 15, Pedro undergoes a brutal period of rehab treatments. As an adult, devastated by a terrible loss, he succumbs completely to his drug addiction. His friends worry that he might OD. In 1970, young Victor takes a risk and makes one more delivery for the drug lord, Ribeiro.

episodes.name: PARTNERS?
episodes.plot: After being rushed to the hospital due to an OD, Pedro gives rehab another shot, far away from Rio de Janeiro. In 1999, at age 18, he’s released from the Juvenile Detention Center. His relationship with his father takes a turn for the worse. In 1970, young Victor strengthens his ties with Ribeiro, the drug lord, and learns all about the operation behind getting drugs delivered to the Favela.

episodes.name: TRAPPED
episodes.plot: Clean and serene after months of rehab, Pedro is lured right back into drugs and crime. The police are on his tail. In 1978, Victor joins the Civil Police and, during an operation in the favela, he runs into an old acquaintance. Disillusioned, he joins a unit that promises to rid Rio de Janeiro of drugs.

episodes.name: TAKING A BREAK
episodes.plot: After an unsuccessful heist and the death of a gang member, Pedro ends up being kidnapped, putting his mother and sister in a risky situation. They come up with a plan to rescue him while Victor, after finding out about his son’s abduction, swears revenge on the perpetrators.

episodes.name: Cops And Criminals
episodes.plot: Rio de Janeiro, 2004. Dom becomes one of the most wanted criminals in the city. The police are on his tail and his face is everywhere on tabloid TV. His gang now has a new member and robberies get more dangerous. In 1978, Victor and Marisa meet and fall in love.

episodes.name: Drying Ice
episodes.plot: A resentful Vivi takes revenge and puts Dom even more at risk, forcing him to flee Rio de Janeiro. Even away from the spotlight, Dom is unable to leave the life of crime. In 1978, Victor tries to resign from the police, but criminals chase him down and threaten his life.

episodes.name: Hybrid Animals
episodes.plot: Vitória, 2004. Under an alias, Dom is arrested alongside Quinado, and both end up separated into rival factions in jail. Dom catches the eye of the faction leader, which causes disagreements within the faction. In 1978, in the Amazon rainforest, Victor witnesses a conflict between loggers, drug dealers, and Indigenous people, and so he begins his journey as an undercover agent in the region.

episodes.name: The Passage
episodes.plot: With Alcione's trust, Dom is invited to take part in a prison break attempt. Quinado tries to tag along, but when the group discovers he's from the rival faction, tensions erupt, and everything is at risk. Meanwhile, Paloma is kidnapped and Victor goes to the state of Pernambuco to search for her. In the Amazon, 1978, Victor begins to unravel the drug trafficking scheme in the region.

episodes.name: The Gospel According To Pedro Dom
episodes.plot: After an unexpected death, Dom ends up in solitary confinement. Upon returning to his cell, he tries to pacify the prison. The deal fails, and Dom moves to the Evangelicals' wing. Meanwhile, Victor discovers Dom's true whereabouts and goes to the state of Espírito Santo to try and save his son, but freedom will be expensive.

episodes.name: The Hunt
episodes.plot: In Rio, the name of Pedro Dom continues to make news headlines, which keeps the police on his tail. In Vitória, Dom tries to buy his freedom after Victor introduces him to a crooked lawyer. In the Amazon, in 1978, Victor witnesses cocaine arriving at the border, but is caught. His life is now at risk.

episodes.name: Outlined Destinies
episodes.plot: Through blackmail, Detective Roberto uses someone Dom loves dearly to get what he wants. Pedro has no other choice but to ask for unusual help. Victor continues to fight for his son's life, but a serious personal problem could ruin everything. In the Amazon, in 1979, Victor is surprised by the direction of the investigation of drug trafficking in the region.

episodes.name: BONUS EPISODE: Like Our Parents
episodes.plot: In this bonus episode that takes place during Brazil’s military dictatorship, the newly graduated police officer Victor Dantas witnesses a bank robbery, but ends up being held hostage by a group of guerrilla fighters who are against the regime. This experience may forever change Victor's views on justice.

episodes.name: È questione di tempo.
episodes.plot: Dom rischia tutto per cercare di vedere sua figlia in ospedale, ma la polizia gli sta con il fiato sul collo. Victor scopre di essere gravemente malato e sente di avere poco tempo per riuscire a salvare suo figlio.

episodes.name: Chi semina vento…
episodes.plot: Dopo aver svaligiato la casa di un noto giornalista, Dom diventa il ricercato numero uno. Le operazioni per la sua cattura si fanno ancora più serrate. Sentendosi vicino alla morte, Victor rivela il lato oscuro del suo passato a Laura.

episodes.name: Tra due mondi.
episodes.plot: Con la polizia alle calcagna, Dom lotta disperatamente per la sua vita, anche se il prezzo da pagare è alto. Dieci anni prima Victor prese parte ad una pericolosa operazione in Colombia

episodes.name: Il bacio della strega.
episodes.plot: Dom, nel tentativo di fuggire alla polizia, tocca il fondo, e finisce in un guaio ancora più grande. Victor stringe un accordo per salvare suo figlio. Questi sono gli ultimi giorni di Dom.

episodes.name: Libero.
episodes.plot: Un incontro speciale potrebbe essere l'unica via per salvare Dom e allontanarlo da una vita da criminale. Victor studia un piano di fuga per suo figlio, ma Dom deve prima saldare il debito con la droga. Queste sono le ultime ore di Dom.
